idea-plugin.name: Amper Tasks
idea-plugin.description:
Native Gradle-style Task Tool Window for Kotlin Amper

Amper Tasks brings the familiar, convenient sidebar experience to Kotlin Amper projects in IntelliJ IDEA. Organize, explore, and run all your Amper tasks and custom shell scripts with a single double-click.

Key Features:

  • Zero Configuration: Automatically detects project.yaml, module.yaml, or ./kotlin wrapper upon opening.
  • Double-Click to Run: Double-click any task or select and press Enter to execute.
  • Integrated Console: Tasks stream directly into IntelliJ's standard Run tool window with ANSI colors and stop (■) control.
  • Smart Multi-Module & Directory Hierarchy: Run project-wide tasks or target specific submodules (-m <module>) without typing, with intermediate folders cleanly organized into directories.
  • Custom Command Groups & Shell Commands: Add custom groups and multiline CLI/shell commands to any project root, directory, or module with configurable working directories.
  • Hide & Declutter: Right-click to hide tasks, groups, or directories to keep your workspace focused, with a toolbar toggle to view hidden items in gray.
  • Persistent Tree State: Remembers your exact expanded and collapsed folders, modules, and task groups across IDE restarts, remaining neatly collapsed by default on fresh projects.
  • Application Run Support: Auto-detects product: app/... modules to provide one-click run tasks.
  • Publishing Discovery: Automatically generates publish tasks for repositories marked with publish: true (mavenLocal, Repsy, etc.).
  • Project & Module Inspection: Quick access to show modules, show tasks, show dependencies, and show settings.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
What's New in v1.0.3

We’re excited to bring you the latest update with new ways to work smarter and a few handy fixes to make your experience smoother.

Highlights

  • Your task tree now remembers which folders were expanded, so you can pick up where you left off without losing your view.
  • New handy tools: Custom Command Groups, Shell Commands, and a Hide & Declutter option let you tailor the plugin to your workflow.
  • Run Amper tasks with a single double‑click for quick access.
  • The plugin UI has been refreshed with clearer installation steps and brand‑new icons.

Improvements & Fixes

  • Fixed a small issue that could cause the plugin to reset unexpectedly — now it’s more stable.
  • The tree view expands correctly when you reopen the plugin.
  • Installation guide updated for easier setup.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of Amper Tasks for IntelliJ IDEA.
  • Full project and module task tree visualization.
  • Double-click task execution in integrated Run console.
  • Auto-detection of application modules and publishable repositories.
